prompts.cover-birds: Create one compact paired educational illustration, transparent background, for a UK gardening book. The supplied images are STYLE references only: bold simplified colour planes, clear dark-green outlines, forest and lime greens, warm brown, cream highlights, polished but not photorealistic. Subject: on the LEFT, a small loose rectangular swatch of dark green OPEN BIRD NETTING, slightly draped with large clearly visible square/diamond holes, approximately 5 holes across and 5 down; behind every hole genuine transparency. On the RIGHT, separate with clear space, a single recognisable British wood pigeon in side view, grey body, darker wing, white neck patch, pinkish breast, two feet. Net and bird do not touch or overlap. No entanglement, no barrier/action scene, no plant, no background, no labels or lettering, no arrows. Landscape paired composition, whole swatch and whole bird fully inside frame. Both subjects equally legible at 46mm total print width. No black backdrop or coloured glow.

prompts.fruit-cage: Create one educational illustration on a genuinely transparent background for a British vegetable gardening book. STYLE references supplied: simplified broad forest/lime-green foliage, warm timber, cream highlights, crisp clean graphic planes rather than photographic texture. Subject: a compact WALK-IN TIMBER FRUIT CAGE in slightly elevated three-quarter view, fully complete. Sturdy timber posts set firmly into soil; horizontal upper rails make a rectangular flat-roof enclosure; small diagonal timber corner braces prevent racking. Four walls and a closed hinged timber-framed door are covered in taut GALVANISED WELDED WIRE MESH with small regular square openings; door has visible hinge and latch and no large perimeter gap. The top is fully covered with lighter bird NETTING supported by rails, not a solid roof, no glass. Include two modest berry bushes with a few redcurrants/raspberries inside and a narrow clear walking route from door, keeping most frame and mesh visible. Plain small earth/grass footprint only, no landscape or sky or people. Full posts, roof and door inside canvas. Wire edges end safely against timber. No words, labels, arrows, product logo, measurements. Landscape approximately 80mm x60mm print. Transparent through all mesh/air gaps. This is a generic construction illustration, not an engineering specification.
prompts.manufactured-frame: Create one educational illustration on a genuinely transparent background for a British gardening book. Match supplied STYLE references: broad graphic colour planes, clear silhouette, forest/lime foliage, cream highlights, minimal soil. Subject: an UNCOVERED temporary modular crop-protection frame of straight silver aluminium tubes joined at right angles with rounded dark green/black moulded socket connectors. Six slender uprights, three on each long side, firmly into soil; top horizontal rails form a rectangular cuboid perimeter; a top crossbar links middle posts. Every top tube end fits fully INSIDE a connector, with no protruding sharp tube tips, and small flush locking screws. No diagonal chimney-like tube extensions, no pitched roof, no extra posts without joints. A few small seedlings on a soil patch beneath, leaving all joints visible. Three-quarter view. At one side include a separate clearly enlarged close-up of a three-way rounded socket joint accepting one vertical and two horizontal tubes at right angles, all ends inside; no leader line or words. Whole frame and detail entirely inside image. No cover: frame geometry is the point; the caption will explain this. No landscape, no lettering, no diagram border or arrows. Landscape for about68mm x40mm print. Not a specific branded replica.
prompts.tennis-frame: Create one clear educational illustration on a genuinely transparent background for a British gardening book. Match supplied STYLE references: crisp bold simplified colour planes, warm golden bamboo, forest/lime greens, cream highlights, restrained texture. Show a small UNCOVERED rectangular netting frame made from FOUR bamboo uprights and FOUR horizontal bamboo top rails. At each of the FOUR upper corners a recognisable yellow-green TENNIS BALL with white curved seam joins THREE cane ends: one upright enters a snug hole in the UNDERSIDE and the two horizontal rails enter separate holes at right angles to each other. Cane ends STOP INSIDE each ball: none protrudes through the top. All four corner balls must visibly cover the sharp tips. Bottoms of uprights are firmly set into a small soil patch; sparse low seedlings. In three-quarter view the four top rails form a simple rectangle, not a wigwam or pitched roof. On the right, clearly separate from frame, show one enlarged tennis-ball corner joint demonstrating precisely these three inserted canes and snug dark hole rims; no unattached floating parts. The enlarged joint can have short cane stubs, the frame must be complete. No net or fleece covering, so construction can be seen. No people, labels, lettering, arrow, landscape or dark background. Full structure and close-up inside frame, landscape about68mm x40mm printed.
